maria_finance: Heads up — Asteria Health invoice from 2026-03-18 shows a large, unexpected usage spike (\u003chttps://redwood.app/billing/invoices/AST-9876|invoice link\u003e). Rough numbers: usage_delta: 1,805,432 tokens. Overage billed: $28,000 total. Ops says this was caused by a canary job using prod keys during a test. Request: manual credit to avoid churn. Proposed credit: $22,400 (80% of overage).

jordan_sales: +1. CSM already escalated — customer worried. Can we confirm dev job traffic and that this isn't legitimate prod load?

alex_ops: Confirmed. We traced to a single CI canary that looped for ~3 hours after a config regression. Logs attached in ticket FIN-7891. Snippet:
```
POST /v1/generate 200 1.7M tokens from canary-job-314
Headers: X-Client: canary/0.2 (prod key)
```
We estimate ~1.7M tokens from that job.

devon_fp&a: Need accounting treatment. Please confirm GL code and whether VAT needs handling. If we credit, book to 'One-off credits' (acct 6102) per policy. Also need a short rationale for the month-end close.

sam_legal: No contract prohibition on credits. Recommend credit memo include: "Issued without admission of liability; one-time adjustment." I can draft language quickly.

billing-bot: Invoice AST-9876 summary: original balance $28,000, unpaid $28,000. Note: applying >$10k manual credit requires finance lead or CFO approval.

elaine_cfo: Quick thought: $22.4k is generous. Can we cap at $18k to avoid setting a precedent? Anything >$20k I want CEO looped in.

maria_finance: Customer is at material risk — they indicated willingness to sign a 12mo Dedicated commit if we resolve promptly. They're an EU customer; VAT handled on their side. GL code: 6102. If that helps, I recommend honoring the $22,400 to secure the commit.

jordan_sales: They said they will sign LOI and expedite CS onboarding if we confirm credit. I can attach the LOI once we have approval.

elaine_cfo: Okay. Approving $22,400 manual credit given the near-term revenue upside and operational confirmation. @sam_legal please draft the memo. @maria_finance please issue credit memo and post to invoice AST-9876. Record in GL acct 6102 and ticket FIN-7891. :white_check_mark:

maria_finance: Done. Credit memo issued, ledger updated (acct 6102), and memo uploaded to invoice AST-9876 link. Ticket FIN-7891 closed. Thanks everyone.
